located.name: Karim Bassani
located.dossier: President of the Republic of Zaristan since 2009 military coup. Former commander of the 4th Armored Division. ICC indictment issued 2024 for crimes against humanity — specifically, systematic targeting of civilian populations in the Khorash Valley campaign (2019-2021), resulting in an estimated 2,300+ civilian deaths. Controls state media, judiciary, and security apparatus. Paranoid personality, rarely appears in public, rotates between 6 known residences. Current intelligence places him at the Presidential Compound in Zarabad. Scheduled to deliver a nationally televised address from the compound on March 10, 2026. Estimated personal wealth: $3.2B held in offshore accounts across 4 jurisdictions. Armed security detail of 40+ at all times.

scheduled_appearances.security_note: Heavy perimeter security, compound access restricted

located.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: Pediatrician with Doctors Without Borders. Deployed to Eastern Congo in January 2026 to provide medical care at a rural clinic serving displaced communities in South Kivu Province. Seized by Forces de Résistance Patriotiques (FRP) militia on February 15 along with 7 colleagues. Mother of two children (ages 3 and 6) residing with her husband Michael Chen in Palo Alto, California. Medical training at Stanford. Fluent in English and Mandarin. Reported in deteriorating health — denied access to her own medication for a chronic thyroid condition.

located.name: James Okonjo
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: Water and sanitation engineer with WaterAid International. Was constructing clean water wells in three villages in South Kivu Province when seized by FRP militia. First international field deployment. Graduated University of Lagos with honors in civil engineering. Grew up in Abuja. Parents: both schoolteachers. Known for his resourcefulness and calm under pressure — colleagues report he has been maintaining morale among the hostage group.

located.name: Maria Santos
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: Veteran nurse practitioner with 18 years of humanitarian field experience across 11 countries. Currently deployed with International Red Cross medical team in Eastern Congo. Mother of three children (ages 12, 15, 19) living with her mother in São Paulo. Has survived two prior hostage situations (South Sudan 2015, Yemen 2019). Described by colleagues as the emotional anchor of the group. Trained in trauma nursing and crisis psychology.

located.name: Dr. Yuki Tanaka
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: Trauma surgeon specializing in conflict-zone medicine. Has operated in 7 conflict zones over 10 years. Was performing emergency surgeries at the MSF field hospital in South Kivu when seized by FRP militia. Unmarried. Published researcher in field surgical techniques under resource constraints. Recognized by WHO for innovations in battlefield triage protocols. Colleagues describe him as methodical and unflappable.

located.name: Erik Lindqvist
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: Logistics coordinator for UNHCR refugee operations. Was managing supply chain for 12,000 displaced persons in South Kivu Province. Third deployment to the region. Engaged to be married in June 2026 to partner Anna Bergström in Stockholm. Experienced in negotiation and local community liaison. Speaks French conversationally, which has been useful in communicating with FRP guards.

located.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: French-English-Arabic translator deployed with UNICEF education program in Eastern Congo. Youngest member of the detained group. Was teaching literacy classes to displaced children in South Kivu when FRP militia established a security cordon. Family in Amman — father is a retired civil servant, mother is a pharmacist. Proficient in 4 languages. Colleagues report she has been translating communications between hostages and captors, playing a critical intermediary role.

located.name: David Kowalski
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
associations: International Committee of the Red Cross
located.dossier: Mission director for the ICRC Eastern Congo country program. Senior-most member of the detained group. 24 years of humanitarian experience. Married to Katarzyna Kowalska — they have no children. Known as a skilled negotiator with extensive contacts across the region. Previously served as ICRC head of delegation in Afghanistan and Democratic Republic of Congo. Has reportedly been attempting to negotiate directly with FRP compound commander, with limited success.

located.name: Amina Diallo
located.location_label: FRP Compound, South Kivu Province, Eastern Congo
located.dossier: Nutritionist with the World Food Programme. Was conducting malnutrition assessments among displaced children in South Kivu Province. Second international deployment — previously served in Chad. Single. Active in community health education. Colleagues describe her as quietly determined and deeply committed to her patients. Has been providing nutritional guidance to the group under limited rations.
